# Default neo-theme buttons to neutral surface and add primary ui

Owned by `@neo-gemini-julia` for the Engine 14 cut (`2026-11-23`), per operator direction (`2026-11-20`), so curated contributor labels are omitted (`ticket-create` §4).

## Context

In PR #21570 (resolving #21179), adding a standard `{module: Button, text: 'Pause'}` inside `examples/grid/animatedRowSorting/Viewport.mjs`'s toolbar produced a filled electric-blue call-to-action button next to neutral `TextField` and `NumberField` controls. While #21393 (PR #21395) and #21399 (PR #21402) reduced default and toolbar button heights in `neo-theme-neo-dark` and `neo-theme-neo-light` from `48 px` to `32 px` (`medium`), both tickets explicitly left button fill out of scope (`#21393`: *"The default button's fill: it stays primary. The defect is its size"*).

## The Problem

1. **Every default `Button` (`ui: null`) in `neo-theme-neo-dark` and `neo-theme-neo-light` renders as a filled primary blue marketing CTA:** `resources/css/theme-neo-dark/button/Base.css:17-42` and `resources/css/theme-neo-light/button/Base.css:17-42` bind `--button-background-color*` to `--cmp-button-primary-surface-*` (`rgb(62, 99, 221)`) with reversed text. Any contributor or maintainer placing `{module: Button}` in a toolbar, header, or `hbox`/`vbox` layout gets a loud primary CTA instead of a calm application control matching adjacent inputs.
2. **`ui: 'primary'` has no structural CSS rule:** `src/button/Base.mjs:162`, `apps/portal/view/examples/Overview.mjs:70` (`'Open the 100,000 × 200 grid'`), and `examples/button/{base,effect}/MainContainer.mjs:192-193` already set `ui: 'primary'` (emitting `.neo-button-primary`), yet `resources/css/src/button/Base.css` only defines `.neo-button-secondary`, `.neo-button-ghost`, and `.neo-button-tertiary`. `.neo-button-primary` worked only because `.neo-button` itself was hardwired to primary blue.

## The Architectural Reality

- `resources/css/src/button/Base.css:12-360` styles `.neo-button` from `--button-*` custom properties and overrides them per variant in `&.neo-button-ghost`, `&.neo-button-secondary`, and `&.neo-button-tertiary`.
- All 5 themes (`theme-neo-dark`, `theme-neo-light`, `theme-dark`, `theme-light`, `theme-cyberpunk`) declare `button/Base.css` custom properties; per #18141 and `buildScripts/util/check-theme-var-references.mjs`, every `--button-<variant>-*` token read in `resources/css/src/button/Base.css` must be declared across all 5 theme sheets so nested theme scopes reset cleanly.
- Audit of `apps/portal/view/**` shows every Portal button already declares an explicit `ui` (`Overview.mjs:70` `ui: 'primary'`, `HeaderToolbar.mjs:54` / `FooterContainer.mjs:55` `ui: 'ghost'`, `AudienceDoors.mjs` / `FeatureSection.mjs:125` / `Examples` controls `ui: 'secondary'`) **except** `apps/portal/view/home/parts/hero/Content.mjs:99-103` (`'Get started'`), which relied on `ui: null` being primary blue.
- Classic themes (`theme-dark`, `theme-light`, `theme-cyberpunk`) already style default `ui: null` buttons as neutral chrome controls (`#3c3f41` gradient in `theme-dark`).
- Design authority: operator direction (`@tobiu`, `2026-11-20`, session `fdac7b58-4686-4e42-9233-7d3e0be881f4`: filled blue buttons *"only make sense for free floating scenarios, like the portal app landing section"*, never as the default inside toolbars, layouts, or headers) and `src/button/Base.mjs:162` (`"The size is independent of ui, which carries a state such as 'primary'"`).

## The Fix

1. **`resources/css/src/button/Base.css`:** Add `&.neo-button-primary` consuming `--button-primary-background-color*`, `--button-primary-background-image`, `--button-primary-border*`, `--button-primary-badge-*`, `--button-primary-glyph-color*`, `--button-primary-ripple-background-color`, and `--button-primary-text-color*` across rest, `:hover`, `:active`, and `&.pressed` (mirroring `&.neo-button-secondary`).
2. **All 5 `resources/css/theme-*/button/Base.css` sheets (`theme-neo-dark`, `theme-neo-light`, `theme-dark`, `theme-light`, `theme-cyberpunk`) + theme template if applicable:**
   - Declare `--button-primary-*` in all 5 themes (`--cmp-button-primary-surface-*` + contrast text in `theme-neo-dark` and `theme-neo-light`; classic button neutral-default tokens in `theme-dark`, `theme-light`, `theme-cyberpunk`).
   - In `theme-neo-dark` and `theme-neo-light`, re-bind base `--button-*` (`ui: null`) to the neutral bordered control tokens (`--cmp-button-secondary-surface-*`, `var(--cmp-button-borderwidth) solid var(--cmp-button-secondary-border-*)`, `--sem-color-text-neutral-*`, `--sem-color-icon-neutral-*`, pressed primary border + `--sem-color-surface-primary-background`). Keep `--button-secondary-*` intact so existing `ui: 'secondary'` callers remain unchanged.
3. **Portal Hero CTA (`apps/portal/view/home/parts/hero/Content.mjs:99`) & `Neo.button.Base` `ui_` JSDoc (`src/button/Base.mjs`):** Add `ui: 'primary'` on `'Get started'` so the landing hero keeps its primary blue CTA alongside `Overview.mjs:70`, and document `ui_` on `Neo.button.Base`.
4. **Build & Tests:** Run `npm run build-themes -- -n -e dev -t all`, pass `check-theme-var-references.mjs`, update `test/playwright/component/button/Pressed.spec.mjs` to cover `UIS = [null, 'primary', 'secondary', 'ghost', 'tertiary']`, and assert in Playwright component tests that `ui: null` renders neutral bordered (`transparent` rest background + `1px` neutral border + neutral text) while `ui: 'primary'` renders filled primary blue in `neo-theme-neo-dark` and `neo-theme-neo-light` without leaking across nested classic scopes.

Decision Record impact: none

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `resources/css/src/button/Base.css` defines `&.neo-button-primary` across rest, `:hover`, `:active`, and `&.pressed`, and all 5 `resources/css/theme-*/button/Base.css` files declare the complete `--button-primary-*` token set (`node buildScripts/util/check-theme-var-references.mjs` passes).
- [ ] AC-2: In `neo-theme-neo-dark` and `neo-theme-neo-light`, a default `Neo.button.Base` (`ui: null`) inside toolbars, headers, or layouts renders with the neutral bordered control surface (`transparent` rest background + `1px` border + neutral text), while `ui: 'primary'` renders the filled primary blue CTA (`rgb(62, 99, 221)` rest background + WCAG `>= 4.5` label contrast in both rest and pressed states).
- [ ] AC-3: `apps/portal/view/home/parts/hero/Content.mjs` (`'Get started'`) explicitly sets `ui: 'primary'`, preserving the Portal landing hero CTA alongside `apps/portal/view/examples/Overview.mjs` (`'Open the 100,000 × 200 grid'`).
- [ ] AC-4: `test/playwright/component/button/Pressed.spec.mjs` passes across `[null, 'primary', 'secondary', 'ghost', 'tertiary']` in all 5 themes, and `npm run test-unit` / `npm run test-components` button & toolbar suites pass.

## Out of Scope

- Re-shooting affected Engine 14 example covers and component tiles into `neomjs/pages` (tracked in the dedicated follow-up ticket `blocked_by` this issue).
- Changing button heights or `size` tokens (#21393, #21399).

## Avoided Traps

- **Scoping the neutral surface to `:where(.neo-toolbar)` only:** Leaves buttons inside `hbox`/`vbox` header containers and layout bars (`Operations Desk`, `Move Video`, `Table Filtering`, form steps) rendering as giant blue CTAs.
- **Declaring `--button-primary-*` in `theme-neo-*` only:** Violates #18141 nested-theme token parity and fails `check-theme-var-references.mjs` when a classic theme sits inside a neo-themed host.
- **Removing `.neo-button-secondary`:** Existing consumers (`AudienceDoors`, `View on GitHub`, `Examples` controls) pass `ui: 'secondary'` explicitly and must keep their exact appearance.
